conduitsVsFlexibleConduit.parentTaxonomy: Flexible Conduit parent=0; Conduits & Fittings parent=Cable Management (525)
conduitsVsFlexibleConduit.reason: Flexible Conduit product set is a near-subset of Conduits & Fittings; TriCab has no recursive Category hierarchy.

glandsVsConduitGlands.reason: Zero shared Products; Glands are cable-entry glands (D-series) while Conduit Glands are conduit connectors (F01–F04) aligned with conduit fittings.

terminalsVsBootlace.reason: Bootlace is a WP child of Terminals with disjoint Products — prefer Series under Terminals, not a second Category.
